keyword: how to choose a diesel concrete pump

title.en: How to Choose a Diesel Concrete Pump from the Xingtai Catalogue
title.zh: 如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists diesel trailer pumps by engine code and kilowatts. Open that hub when the site cannot hold an electric motor. Price is confirmed only by inquiry.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台按柴油机型号和千瓦列出柴油拖泵。现场带不住电机时打开这一类。价格只通过询盘确认。

h1.en: Choose a Diesel Concrete Pump from the Xingtai Diesel Hub
h1.zh: 从邢台柴油分类页选一台柴油混凝土泵

directAnswer.en: Choose a diesel concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai by opening the diesel hub, not by renaming an electric row. Each page prints its own engine, such as 4105 / 56 kW on Diesel 30 or 6105 / 99 kW on Diesel 50. Read that page’s output, pressure and distance, then send the engine code with the inquiry. The catalogue does not print a list price.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购柴油混凝土泵，应打开柴油分类页，而不是把电动行改个名字。每一页有自己的发动机，例如柴油30的 4105 / 56 kW，柴油50的 6105 / 99 kW。读该页的输送量、压力和距离，询盘时带上发动机型号。目录不印标价。

heading.en: Which diesel pages are on the hub?

body.en: The diesel hub names Diesel 30, Diesel 40, Diesel 50, Diesel 60, LZ-60, LZ-80, Diesel 120, the tractor-driven 4100 pump and the rural diesel pump. Start at [/en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/](/en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/). Mixer pumps sit on a different hub even when they use a diesel engine.
body.zh: 柴油分类页包括柴油30、柴油40、柴油50、柴油60、LZ-60、LZ-80、柴油120、拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵。从 [/zh/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/](/zh/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/) 进入。即便用柴油机，搅拌泵也在另一个分类。

heading.en: Which cells are the buying cells?

body.en: Read the diesel engine line, theoretical output, outlet pressure, hopper if printed, and the distance labels. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30. Diesel 120 prints two 145 kW engines, 290 kW total, and 100 m³/h. A blank aggregate cell, as on Diesel 60, stays blank.
body.zh: 看柴油机一行、理论输送量、出口压力、印了才算的料斗，以及距离标题。柴油30印的是 15 m³/h，不是 30。柴油120印两台 145 kW、合计 290 kW、100 m³/h。柴油60的骨料格子是空的，就保持空白。

heading.en: What must the inquiry say about power?

body.en: State that the site will run on diesel, and name the engine printed on the page you opened. Send aggregate, required output, horizontal and vertical metres, country and purchase timing to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Do not ask Xingtai for a published lead time. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a fixed number of production days.
body.zh: 写明现场用柴油，并写上你打开的那一页所印的发动机。把骨料、目标输送量、水平与垂直米数、国家和采购时间发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。不要向邢台索取已公布的交期。河北品锦机械不印固定生产天数。

question.en: Is Diesel 30 the diesel copy of Electric 30?
question.zh: 柴油30是电动30的柴油版吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and 60 m / 180 m. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor and 12–15 m³/h with two distance rows. Order the page you opened.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m。电动30印 30 kW 电机和 12–15 m³/h，并有两行距离。订你打开的那一页。

question.en: Does the diesel hub include the mixer?
question.zh: 柴油分类包含搅拌泵吗？

answer.en: The mixer pumps have their own hub. The diesel mixer is [/en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/](/en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/), not Diesel 40, even though both mention a 4108 engine.
answer.zh: 搅拌泵有自己的分类。柴油搅拌泵在 [/zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/](/zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/)，不是柴油40，尽管两者都提到 4108。

answer.en: No. Ask Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai to confirm the price on the contact page.
answer.zh: 没有。请在询盘页请河北品锦机械（邢台）确认价格。

question.en: What if the site has a stable grid?

answer.en: Start on the electric hub and match motor kilowatts. A diesel row is for a site that will not feed the listed electric motor.
answer.zh: 先打开电动分类，对照电机千瓦。柴油行用于现场不会给所列电机供电的情况。
